{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid search scope Type 2''' was a detector that aided [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in scanning for traps or other security measures. This version was a more advanced version of the [[Droid search scope Type 1|Type 1]], though successful detection depended mostly on the complexity of the device to be detected.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
